# Lembaranz
> Self-Hosted Credential & Note Vault — v1.0.1

## About
Lembaranz is a self-hosted, zero-knowledge credential manager. Data is encrypted locally with AES-GCM 256-bit + Argon2id before storage. No cloud, no tracking, no account required. Runs as a TUI (Terminal User Interface) via the `lembaranz` command.

## Package Architecture

```
packages/
  core/   — @lembaranz/core — Encryption engine & storage adapters
  cli/    — @lembaranz/cli  — TUI (Ink/React) + CLI commands
  web/    — @lembaranz/web  — Local-only web UI (DO NOT DEPLOY to public)
```

### Monorepo Workspace
- Root manifest: `lembaran/package.json`
- Launch TUI: `bun ./packages/cli/src/main.ts` (or installed `lembaranz`)
- All workspace packages use `workspace:*` for internal dependencies

## Core Package Architecture (`packages/core/src/`)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `Vault.ts` | Cryptography engine (AES-GCM 256, Argon2id KDF) |
| `Archive.ts` | High-level CRUD for credentials & notes |
| `Storage.ts` | Storage abstraction layer |
| `Sentinel.ts` | Rate limiting, brute-force protection, constant-time compare |
| `Integrity.ts` | SHA-256 tamper detection for file-backed store |
| `Password.ts` | BIP39 mnemonic generation & validation |
| `Context.ts` | Context/path resolver — **Node-only**, not for browser |
| `AuditLog.ts` | Append-only audit trail |
| `Formula.ts` | Structured config schema (VaultContext types) |
| `Senses.ts` | Input sanitization helpers |
| `storage/FileAdapter.ts` | JSON-file storage adapter (Node.js only) |
| `storage/BrowserAdapter.ts` | IndexedDB adapter (browser only) |
| `storage/types.ts` | Shared storage interface types |
| `index.ts` | Public API barrel export |

## Critical AI Rules

### ⚠️ Sentinel Import — CLI Only
Sentinel is exported from `index.ts` BUT imports `node:child_process` internally.
Never import it in browser/web bundles:

```typescript
// ✅ SAFE in CLI/Node context
import { Sentinel } from '@lembaranz/core';

// ❌ DANGEROUS in browser — will bundle node:child_process
// Use BrowserAdapter pattern instead
```

### ⚠️ Context.ts — Node-only
`Context.ts` uses `node:fs` and must never be imported in browser bundles.

### Test Timeouts
`deriveKey` tests require 15s timeout — Argon2id at m=64KB, t=3 intentionally takes ~7s.
Do NOT lower the KDF parameters. It is the security cost of brute-force resistance.

### Package Names (single 'z')
```typescript
import { Archive, Vault } from '@lembaranz/core'; // ✅
import { ... } from '@lembaranzz/core'; // ❌ old, wrong
```

### Error Pattern
All async functions return `Result<T>` — never throw:
```typescript
type Result<T> = { data: T; error: null } | { data: null; error: Error };
```

## CLI Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `lembaranz` | Launch TUI (default) |
| `lembaranz setup` | Interactive setup wizard |
| `lembaranz config` | Manage `.env` files via vault |
| `lembaranz browse [keyword]` | Search archive |
| `lembaranz import <path>` | Import `.md` or `.lembaranz` backup |
| `lembaranz export` | Export encrypted portable backup |
| `lembaranz settings` | Manage settings / install git hook |
| `lembaranz monitor` | System health & integrity |
| `lembaranz security` | Security dashboard |

## Vault Contexts

| Context | Path | Use Case |
|---------|------|----------|
| `saku` | `~/.lembaranz/` | Personal/global vault |
| `pelataran` | `./.lembaranz/` | Project-local vault |

## Dev Commands

```bash
bun ./packages/cli/src/main.ts          # Run CLI directly
bun test packages/core/src/__tests__/   # Run all tests
bun run lint                             # ESLint all packages
```

## Repository Structure
```
lembaran/          ← This directory (published mono)
  packages/core/   ← @lembaranz/core — npm published
  packages/cli/    ← @lembaranz/cli  — npm published (installs as `lembaranz`)
  packages/web/    ← @lembaranz/web  — NOT published (local GUI only)
  install.sh       ← One-line installer
  docs/            ← id/ & en/ documentation
lembaran-web/      ← Public landing page (deployed separately)
lembaran-review/   ← QA & testing workspace
```

## Security Model
- Zero-knowledge: password never stored, only Argon2id-derived key held in memory
- Auto-lock: vault locks after inactivity (Sentinel)
- Tamper detection: SHA-256 integrity check on every read (Integrity.ts)
- Rate limiting: 5 attempts, 5-minute lockout (Sentinel.checkRateLimit)
- Backup format: `LMBR` magic bytes, v1, Salt(32)+IV(12)+Ciphertext
